text: The Board confirms that each of these nominees is qualified to serve under the provisions of the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework for Community Centre Boards of Management. These appointments are a result of the following public member's terms coming to an end: - Kuda Wamambo, resigned effective August 22, 2023 - Nota Chaggaris, resigned effective September 12, 2023 - Eric Saarvala, resigned effective April 24, 2024, On behalf of the Board, I respectfully request that the City take the necessary steps to appoint these nominated candidates: - Violeta Rangel, for a term of office ending June 23, 2026. - Federico Cervantes, for a term of office ending June 23, 2026.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following individuals to the Central Eglinton Community Centre Board of Management at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending June 23, 2026 and until successors are appointed: - Violeta Rangel; and - Federico Cervantes.
